name: Brorphine
summary: Brorphine is a piperidine-based opioid analgesic compound. Brorphine was originally described in a 2018 paper investigating functionally biased opioid compounds, with the intention of finding safer analgesics that produce less respiratory depression than typical opioids.

pharmacology.text: Brorphine was originally reported to be highly biased, with an EC50 of 4.8nM for GTPγS binding and 182nM for β-arrestin recruitment, however a more recent study found no significant bias for any of the compounds tested, including brorphine.

uses.text: Despite the lack of safety information on the compound, brorphine has been sold as a designer drug since mid-2019, initially being identified in the US Midwest, though it has since been found in 2020 in Belgium.

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied properly in people. Like other strong opioids it slows breathing and has been linked to many deaths, and it also causes drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體經過適當研究。和其他強效鴉片類一樣，它會減緩呼吸，並與許多死亡案例有關，同時造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体经过适当研究。和其他强效鸦片类一样，它会减缓呼吸，并与许多死亡案例有关，同时造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与成瘾。

fact.en: It came out of research into biased opioids, compounds meant to relieve pain while triggering less of the signalling thought to slow breathing. Later work found no real bias, and it reached the street anyway.
fact.zh: 它出自對「偏向性鴉片類」的研究，這類化合物原本設計為止痛的同時較少觸發被認為會抑制呼吸的訊號途徑。後續研究並未發現真正的偏向性，而它仍流入街頭。
fact.zhHans: 它出自对「偏向性鸦片类」的研究，这类化合物原本设计为止痛的同时较少触发被认为会抑制呼吸的信号途径。后续研究并未发现真正的偏向性，而它仍流入街头。
